summary: Ceragon Networks filed a routine Form 6-K attaching an investor-relations notice that management will attend the 17th Annual Craig-Hallum Alpha Select Conference in New York on November 17, 2026, and the 7th Annual Needham Tech Week one-on-one event virtually November 18-20, 2026. CEO Doron Arazi and CFO Ronen Stein will hold one-on-one meetings; no terms, transactions, or structural changes are disclosed. This is an ordinary conference-participation announcement for a foreign private issuer, akin to a US company 8-K investor-calendar notice, and carries no special-situation or deal relevance to monitor.
